name: ball-and-plate-track
$comment: Trajectory tracking: the LQR/Kalman controller with the reference feed-forward (plate angle from the reference acceleration and jerk) follows a figure-8 (task 3, 0.2 x 0.12 m, 8 s period); task 2 is a circle of radius 0.08 m, 6 s period. Both grow from the centre over 3 s.
